title: A service-named process runs python3
threat_model: An attacker who controls a network service makes it run an interpreter directly, so a python3 process is a child of a process that carries the service's name.
notes: The service is a copy of bash named nginx in the scenario work directory, started by the action after the loader. Its command string ends in ; : so that it forks python3 and the python3 is a direct child with the marker as an argument. shell_from_service does not apply because python3 is not a shell, and interpreter_chain sees a run of 1 because nginx is not a watched program, so no alert is listed as acceptable.
